method: Fresh isolated word ASR and independent CTC plus same-condition old/new signal analysis and independent peer review.

results.summary: Independent isolated CTC recognizes the full expected sequence f ɔːɹ ɾ i s ɪ k s; the selected context take has an unvoiced fricative onset and zero preceding voiced-prefix frames. Source hashes match every recognition and signal record. ASR interprets the isolated cardinal correctly.

evidence.summary: Fresh isolated complete CTC sequence matches f ɔːɹ ɾ i s ɪ k s without preceding extra phonemes.
Same 20ms/10ms signal analysis compares the unchanged old source with the new source; voiced prefix becomes zero.
Six source hashes measured; no suspicious voiced terminal tail. Weak final stop detection is reviewed in peer addendum.
Preserved initial independent review; its overly strict strong-frication deadline for weak /f/ is explicitly resolved by the addendum.
Independent peer addendum passes all six exact source hashes, including weak /f/, complete vowels, and the final weak /t/.
